repos.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
repos.summary_zh: n8n 是一款面向技术团队的安全工作流自动化平台，融合可视化拖拽与自定义代码（JavaScript/Python），支持 400+ 集成和原生 AI 能力（基于 LangChain），提供自托管或云端部署选项，采用公平源代码许可，确保数据控制与可定制性。
repos.summary_en: n8n is a secure workflow automation platform combining visual building with custom code (JavaScript/Python), offering 400+ integrations, native AI capabilities via LangChain, and flexible deployment options—self-hosted or cloud—under a fair-code license for full data control and extensibility.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: Everything Claude Code 是一个专为 AI 智能体性能优化设计的完整系统，涵盖技能、直觉、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cowork 等平台，提供生产级代理、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置，适用于多语言环境，是 Anthropic 黑客马拉松获奖作品。
repos.summary_en: Everything Claude Code is a comprehensive performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, featuring skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, and more, offering production-ready agents, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configurations, evolved over 10+ months of real-world use.

repos.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 是一款开源 AI 智能体，将 Gemini 的强大功能直接集成到终端中，提供对 Gemini 3 模型的轻量级访问，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令等内置工具，并具备 MCP 扩展能力，专为命令行开发者设计，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
repos.summary_en: Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal, offering lightweight access to Gemini 3 models with built-in tools like Google Search, file operations, and shell commands, plus extensibility via MCP (Model Context Protocol), designed for developers who live in the command line.

repos.description: A collection of MCP servers.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome MCP Servers 是一个精心策划的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器集合，涵盖文件访问、数据库连接、API集成等场景，支持本地与云端服务。项目提供多语言 README 和活跃社区支持，并配有在线目录与测试工具，助力开发者快速集成 AI 能力至各类应用。
repos.summary_en: Awesome MCP Servers is a curated collection of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers enabling secure AI interactions with local and remote resources. It includes production-ready and experimental servers for file access, databases, APIs, and more, with multilingual documentation, community support, and integrated testing tools via glama.ai.

repos.description: Model Context Protocol Servers
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方参考服务器实现，涵盖文件操作、网络抓取、Git 管理、内存存储等场景，支持多语言 SDK（Python、TypeScript 等），旨在帮助开发者理解 MCP 架构并构建安全的 LLM 工具集成方案。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers reference implementations of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including file system access, web fetching, Git operations, and memory management. Built with multi-language SDKs (Python, TypeScript, etc.), it serves as an educational resource for developers to build secure LLM-integrated tools using MCP.

repos.description: Autonomous coding agent as an SDK, IDE extension, or CLI assistant.
repos.summary_zh: Cline 是一款集成在 IDE 中的自主编码代理，基于 Claude Sonnet 的代理能力，支持文件创建/编辑、终端命令执行、浏览器操作等，全程需用户授权。通过 AST 分析、正则搜索和上下文管理，可处理复杂开发任务，支持 MCP 扩展工具，提供安全的 AI 编程辅助。
repos.summary_en: Cline is an autonomous coding agent integrated directly into your IDE, powered by Claude Sonnet's agentic capabilities. It can create/edit files, execute terminal commands, use browsers, and more—with your permission at every step. Designed for complex software development tasks through AST analysis, regex searches, and context-aware workflows, it extends functionality via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while maintaining human oversight for safety.

repos.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。
repos.summary_zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控工具，支持多平台热点聚合、RSS 订阅与智能关键词筛选，提供 AI 翻译与分析简报推送。集成微信/飞书/钉钉等 8+ 通知渠道，支持 Docker 部署与 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测，30 秒快速部署。
repos.summary_en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates multi-platform hot topics, RSS feeds, and offers smart keyword filtering. It delivers AI-translated analysis briefs via 8+ notification channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, etc.), supports Docker deployment and MCP architecture for AI-driven sentiment analysis and trend forecasting, with a 30-second setup.

repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是一款基于 AI 智能体的逆向工程工具，支持从应用程序行为到原生二进制的全栈代码审查。它通过 MCP 协议无缝集成 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 助手，可静态分析 JavaScript、.NET 及动态分析二进制文件，支持 Hopper/Ghidra 引擎，帮助开发者深入理解软件实现机制并快速复用功能。
repos.summary_en: REA is an AI agent-driven reverse engineering tool for full-stack code inspection from app behavior to native binaries. It integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI assistants via MCP protocol, supporting static analysis of JavaScript, .NET assemblies, and dynamic binary analysis with Hopper/Ghidra engines. Developers can inspect undocumented apps, understand implementation details, and rebuild features for their own projects.

repos.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Chrome DevTools MCP 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Gemini、Claude、Cursor 等）设计的 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议实现浏览器自动化、性能分析与深度调试。支持网络请求分析、截图、控制台日志追踪及性能追踪，结合 Puppeteer 实现可靠操作，适用于网页自动化与智能调试场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome DevTools MCP is an MCP server enabling AI coding agents (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It provides advanced debugging, performance tracing, network analysis, and screenshot capabilities using Puppeteer for reliable automation, ideal for web automation and intelligent debugging.

repos.description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows, automation, and chat apps
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是一个超轻量级个人 AI 助手，灵感来自 OpenClaw，核心功能仅约 4,000 行代码，比 Clawdbot 缩小 99%。支持多平台通信（Slack、Discord、Feishu、DingTalk 等）、MCP 协议、多模态文件处理及智能会话管理，具备高可靠性与模块化扩展能力，适用于个人自动化与智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant inspired by OpenClaw, delivering core agent functionality in just ~4,000 lines of code—99% smaller than Clawdbot. It supports multi-platform messaging (Slack, Discord, Feishu, etc.), MCP protocol, multimodal file handling, and robust session management, offering high reliability and modular extensibility for personal automation and intelligent interaction.

repos.description: Open-source coding agent for your terminal, built in Rust and on a journey of continuous community improvement. Issues and PRs welcome.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale是一款基于Rust构建的开源终端AI编码代理，支持连接多种大模型提供商（含Ollama/vLLM本地部署），具备文件编辑、命令执行、任务规划等完整能力。采用分层审批机制保障执行安全，支持MCP协议扩展与Agent协作，可持久化会话与目标管理，适用于开发者终端工作流自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source Rust-based AI coding agent for the terminal, connecting to various LLM providers including local Ollama/vLLM deployments. It supports file editing, command execution, and task planning with tiered approval for safety. Features MCP extensibility, multi-agent coordination, and session persistence, ideal for developer terminal automation workflows.

repos.description: A powerful MCP toolkit for coding, providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities  - the IDE for your agent
repos.summary_zh: Serena 是一个强大的编码代理工具包，通过语义检索和编辑能力（MCP 服务器等集成）将 LLM 转变为可直接操作代码库的全功能代理。它提供类似 IDE 的符号级代码检索与编辑工具，显著提升大模型在代码理解与修改中的效率与准确性，支持多种 LLM 集成方式，包括 MCP、OpenAPI 及自定义代理框架。
repos.summary_en: Serena is a powerful coding agent toolkit that transforms an LLM into a fully-featured agent capable of directly operating on your codebase. It provides IDE-like semantic code retrieval and editing tools at the symbol level, greatly improving token efficiency and code quality. Serena integrates with LLMs via MCP, OpenAPI, or custom agent frameworks, enabling precise code navigation and modification without full-file reads or string replacements.

repos.description: 🚀 The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers and clients.
repos.summary_zh: FastMCP 是构建 MCP 服务器和客户端的快速 Pythonic 框架，提供声明式工具定义、自动生成 Schema 和文档、内置协议协商与认证机制，支持从原型到生产的一站式开发，已集成至官方 MCP Python SDK 并成为行业标准。
repos.summary_en: FastMCP is a fast, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients. It enables declarative tool definition, automatic schema generation, protocol negotiation, and authentication, streamlining development from prototype to production. Integrated into the official MCP Python SDK, it powers 70% of MCP servers globally.

repos.description: MCP for xiaohongshu.com
repos.summary_zh: 小红书 MCP 是一个专为 xiaohongshu.com 设计的自动化工具，支持登录验证、图文/视频内容发布、内容搜索、推荐列表获取、帖子详情抓取、评论互动及用户主页信息提取。采用本地路径优先的图片处理机制，确保上传稳定性，并提供完整的 HTTP API 与 MCP 工具调用支持，适用于内容运营与数据采集场景。
repos.summary_en: Xiaohongshu MCP is an automation tool designed for xiaohongshu.com, supporting login verification, publishing text/image and video content, searching posts, fetching recommended feeds, retrieving post details with interactions, commenting, and user profile data extraction. It prioritizes local file paths for media uploads to ensure stability, and offers full HTTP API and MCP tool integration for content operations and data collection.

repos.description: 小红书（XiaoHongShu、RedNote）链接提取/作品采集工具
repos.summary_zh: XHS-Downloader 是一款功能强大的小红书（XiaoHongShu/RedNote）作品采集与下载工具，支持提取账号作品、收藏、点赞链接，采集作品信息及下载地址，批量下载图文、视频、LivePhoto 文件，具备断点续传、文件完整性校验、自定义命名格式、剪贴板监听、MCP 调用等高级功能，适用于内容创作者与数据收集场景。
repos.summary_en: XHS-Downloader is a powerful tool for extracting and downloading content from Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote). It supports fetching posts, likes, collections, and albums, downloading media files (images, videos, LivePhotos), with features like resume downloads, file integrity checks, custom naming, clipboard monitoring, and MCP integration, ideal for content creators and data collectors.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server 是一款基于 Chrome 扩展的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，将浏览器功能暴露给 Claude 等 AI 助手，实现复杂浏览器自动化、内容分析与语义搜索。它直接利用用户现有 Chrome 环境，保留登录状态与配置，支持 20+ 工具，提供本地流式 HTTP 通信，并集成 SIMD 加速的向量数据库，实现智能跨标签页语义检索。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex automation, content analysis, and semantic search. It leverages your existing Chrome browser with preserved login states and settings, supports 20+ tools, offers local streamable HTTP communication, and features SIMD-accelerated vector database for intelligent tab content discovery.

repos.description: ChatGPT thinks. Codex works. Use ChatGPT as the planning brain while keeping the Codex harness.
repos.summary_zh: 将 ChatGPT 网页版作为 Codex 编码会话的规划与审查大脑，执行权完全保留在 Codex。通过 OAuth 保护的只读 MCP 连接按需读取代码，仓库永不上传，无需 API Key 或逆向代理，充分利用付费订阅额度。
repos.summary_en: Uses the ChatGPT web app as the planning and review brain for Codex coding sessions, while Codex retains full execution control. Secure read-only MCP connection via OAuth reads only needed code; repo is never uploaded. No API key or reverse proxy required.

repos.description: A collection of MCP clients.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome MCP Clients 是一个精心策划的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 客户端集合，涵盖 CLI、桌面应用、AI 助手等多种类型，支持跨平台运行，旨在扩展 AI 模型对本地和远程资源的访问能力，提升智能交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Awesome MCP Clients is a curated collection of Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, including CLI tools, desktop apps, and AI assistants, supporting cross-platform use to extend AI models' access to local and remote resources for enhanced intelligent interaction.

repos.description: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world
repos.summary_zh: DeepChat 是一个功能丰富的开源 AI 智能体平台，统一整合模型、工具和智能体，支持多 LLM 对话、MCP 工具调用和 ACP 智能体集成，提供强大的桌面端 AI 助手体验。
repos.summary_en: DeepChat is a powerful open-source AI agent platform that unifies models, tools, and agents, offering multi-LLM chat, MCP tool calling, and ACP agent integration for seamless desktop AI assistance.

repos.summary_zh: Craft Agents 是一款基于 Agent Native 理念构建的开源桌面应用，支持通过自然语言连接任意 API、MCP 服务或本地工具（如 Linear、Gmail、Slack、PostgreSQL 等），无需配置文件。它集成 Claude 与 Pi SDK，提供多会话管理、实时技能扩展和文档中心化工作流，用户仅需描述需求即可自动完成集成与任务执行。
repos.summary_en: Craft Agents is an open-source desktop application built on Agent Native principles, enabling natural language integration with any API, MCP service, or local tool (e.g., Linear, Gmail, Slack, PostgreSQL) without config files. It combines Claude and Pi SDKs to offer multi-session management, real-time skill expansion, and a document-centric workflow—users simply describe what they want, and the agent handles execution.

repos.description: ⚡️next-generation personal AI assistant powered by LLM, RAG and agent loops, supporting computer-use, browser-use and coding agent, demo: https://demo.openagentai.org
repos.summary_zh: OpenAgent 是一款开源的企业级 AI 知识库与智能体管理平台，支持 MCP/A2A 协议，集成 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama 等主流大模型，提供带单点登录的管理后台和用户界面，适用于构建私有化 AI 应用与多智能体协作系统。
repos.summary_en: OpenAgent is an open-source enterprise-grade AI knowledge base and agent management platform supporting MCP/A2A protocols. It integrates major LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, and Llama, offering admin UI, user management, and SSO for secure, scalable AI application deployment.

repos.description: The go-to web for your AI coding agent — local-first search, fetch, crawl & research over MCP. No API keys, no cloud, $0/query. Public beta.
repos.summary_zh: wigolo 是一款本地优先的 AI 智能体网页情报 MCP 服务器，为 AI 编程助手提供搜索、抓取、爬取及自主研究能力。它完全运行于本地（~/.wigolo/），无需 API 密钥或云服务，实现零成本查询，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流工具，是 AI 时代替代传统付费搜索 API 的隐私保护方案。
repos.summary_en: wigolo is a local-first MCP server delivering web intelligence for AI coding agents. It provides search, fetch, crawl, and autonomous research capabilities entirely on-device without API keys or cloud services. Supporting Claude Code, Cursor, and other major tools, it offers a privacy-focused, zero-cost alternative to metered search APIs.

repos.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Deep Research 是一个基于 AI 的极速深度研究工具，支持多 LLM 模型（如 Gemini、OpenAI、Anthropic 等）和主流搜索引擎，可在约 2 分钟内生成高质量研究报告。采用 Thinking 与 Task 模型协同工作，支持本地知识库构建、知识图谱可视化、内容编辑与历史记录管理，所有数据均本地处理，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Deep Research is an AI-powered tool for lightning-fast in-depth research, supporting multiple LLMs (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) and search engines. It generates comprehensive reports in ~2 minutes using Thinking and Task models, with local knowledge base, knowledge graph, content editing, and full privacy via on-device processing.

repos.description: ⚡️AI Cloud OS: Open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP (model-context-protocol)/A2A (agent-to-agent) management platform with admin UI, user management and Single-Sign-On⚡️, supports ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, HuggingFace, etc., chat bot demo: https://ai.casibase.com, admin UI demo: https://ai-admin.casibase.com
repos.summary_zh: Casibase 是一个开源企业级 AI 知识库与 MCP/A2A 管理平台，提供管理员界面、用户管理及单点登录功能，支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama、Ollama 等多种模型，具备完整的知识库管理、智能对话和 Agent 协作能力。
repos.summary_en: Casibase is an open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP/A2A management platform featuring admin UI, user management, and SSO, supporting ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, and more, with full knowledge management and agent collaboration capabilities.

repos.description: Chrome extension & CLI to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
repos.summary_zh: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

repos.description: Enhanced MCP server for interactive user feedback and command execution in AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and Desktop Application) with intelligent environment detection and cross-platform compatibility.
repos.summary_zh: MCP Feedback Enhanced 是一个增强型 MCP 服务器，专为 AI 辅助开发设计，支持 Web UI 和跨平台桌面应用双界面，具备智能环境检测与反馈驱动工作流，可显著降低平台成本并提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: MCP Feedback Enhanced is an enhanced MCP server designed for AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and cross-platform desktop app) with intelligent environment detection and feedback-driven workflows to reduce platform costs and boost development efficiency.

repos.description: 面向 AI Agent 的微信公众号创作与发布 CLI：Markdown 排版、AI 配图、预览与草稿创建；支持由浏览器 Agent 保存知乎、CSDN、头条未发布草稿。
repos.summary_zh: md2wechat 是一款专为 AI 时代设计的公众号创作工具，支持用 Markdown 编写文章并一键转换为精美排版，自动上传至微信草稿箱。提供 43 个高级排版模块、40+ 专业主题、AI 配图及批量发布功能，全流程 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code 等智能体，让公众号写作高效如发朋友圈。
repos.summary_en: md2wechat is an AI-native WeChat article creation tool that converts Markdown into beautifully formatted posts and auto-uploads to the draft box. It offers 43 advanced layout modules, 40+ professional themes, AI image generation, and batch publishing via CLI, with native support for agents like Claude Code.

repos.description: ChatMCP is an AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
repos.summary_zh: ChatMCP 是一款跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，完整实现 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，支持 MacOS、Windows、Linux、iOS、Android 和 Web 多端运行。提供本地存储、数据同步、LaTeX 渲染、Mermaid 图表生成、HTML 预览及多 LLM 模型接入等功能，适用于智能对话与工具集成场景。
repos.summary_en: ChatMCP is a cross-platform AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), supporting MacOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and Web. It offers local storage, data sync, LaTeX rendering, Mermaid diagram generation, HTML preview, and multi-LLM provider integration for intelligent conversations and tool workflows.

repos.description: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
repos.summary_zh: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
repos.summary_en: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款开源免费的 macOS 原生系统管理工具，集垃圾清理、应用卸载、磁盘分析、重复文件查找和实时状态监控于一体。内置 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 代理安全可控地监控和维护 Mac，所有操作可审计、可回滚。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS system management tool that combines junk cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, duplicate finding, and live status monitoring. It features a built-in MCP server for AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor to safely monitor and maintain your Mac, with all actions consent-gated, audited, and reversible.

repos.description: Full-stack AI agent for coding, files, terminals, tools, research, content, multimodal work, and multi-agent workflows.
repos.summary_zh: ProxyCast 是一款基于 Tauri 的本地优先 AI Agent 创作工作台，整合 Workspace、Skills、MCP 标准能力与 Claw 渠道协作，实现从灵感到可发布内容的闭环流程。支持文档生成、研究整理、多平台异步协作及浏览器/终端扩展执行，适合创作者与知识工作者高效沉淀可复用资产。
repos.summary_en: ProxyCast is a local-first AI Agent workspace built with Tauri, integrating Workspace, Skills, MCP-standardized capabilities, and Claw channel collaboration to close the loop from idea to publishable content. It supports document generation, research organization, cross-platform async workflows, and browser/terminal extensions, ideal for creators and knowledge workers to streamline reusable output.

repos.description: BrowserWing turns your browser actions into MCP commands Or Claude Skill, allowing AI agents to control browsers efficiently and reliably. Say goodbye to slow, token-heavy LLM interactions — let agents call commands directly for faster automation. Perfect for AI-driven tasks, browser automation, and boosting productivity.
repos.summary_zh: BrowserWing 是一款原生浏览器自动化平台，支持通过 MCP 协议和 Claude Skill 让 AI 智能体直接控制浏览器。提供 26+ HTTP API 接口、可视化脚本录制、LLM 驱动的数据提取及会话管理，实现高效可靠的浏览器自动化，显著减少 LLM 交互延迟。
repos.summary_en: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

repos.description: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons
repos.summary_zh: Better Icons 是一个图标搜索与检索工具，提供20万+图标资源，支持150+主流图标库（如 Lucide、Heroicons）。可作为 MCP 服务器集成到 AI 编程助手（Cursor/Claude等），或作为 CLI 工具直接调用。具备智能学习、批量获取、跨框架导出等功能，显著提升开发者在 AI 辅助编码中的图标使用效率。
repos.summary_en: Better Icons is a skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections (e.g., Lucide, Heroicons). It integrates with AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code via MCP, or functions as a CLI tool. Features include auto-learning usage patterns, batch retrieval, multi-framework exports (React/Vue/Svelte), and direct SVG output to save tokens in AI chats.

repos.description: Claude Code 中文开发套件 - 为中国开发者定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境。一键安装完整中文化体验，集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描，支持免翻墙访问。让 AI 编程更简单。
repos.summary_zh: Claude Code 中文开发套件是为中国开发者量身定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境，提供一键安装的全中文化体验。集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描等核心功能，支持免翻墙访问。最新版本融合 Anthropic 黑客松冠军配置，包含 9 个专用智能体、7+ 技能模块、10 个快捷指令和完整规则体系，实现从需求分析到代码审查的全流程 AI 驱动开发。
repos.summary_en: Claude Code Chinese Development Kit is a zero-threshold AI programming environment tailored for Chinese developers, offering one-click installation with full Chinese localization. It integrates MCP servers, intelligent context management, security scanning, and supports direct access without VPN. The latest version incorporates the Anthropic Hackathon-winning configuration, featuring 9 specialized agents, 7+ skill modules, 10 slash commands, and a complete rule system for end-to-end AI-driven development workflows.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents. Coming to Windows
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS GUI 工具，为 Mole CLI 提供可视化操作界面。它集成了磁盘清理、应用卸载、系统优化、磁盘分析及实时状态监控功能，并支持长期历史记录与本地 MCP 服务器，方便 AI 智能体通过自然语言直接操控系统维护任务，即将支持 Windows 平台。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS GUI for the Mole CLI engine. It bundles disk cleaning, app uninstallation, system optimization, disk analysis, and live status monitoring. Featuring long-range history and a local MCP server, it enables AI agents to autonomously diagnose and resolve system issues via natural language, with a Windows version in preview.

repos.description: 一款完全开源的微信公众号文章获取、RSS 订阅 API 服务，支持整号文章一键导出 7 种格式（Markdown/HTML/Word/PDF/EPUB/Excel/JSON）、IP 代理池反风控、MCP 接入各种 AI Agent 工具。
repos.summary_zh: 完全开源的微信公众号文章获取与RSS订阅API服务，支持Chrome TLS指纹模拟、SOCKS5代理池反风控，提供公众号搜索、文章抓取、图片代理及Webhook通知功能。基于FastAPI构建，支持Docker一键部署和多架构兼容，本地扫码登录即可使用。
repos.summary_en: Fully open-source WeChat public account article fetching and RSS subscription API service with Chrome TLS fingerprint simulation, SOCKS5 proxy pool anti-detection, supporting account search, article scraping, image proxy, and webhook notifications. Built on FastAPI, Docker-deployable across multiple architectures, accessible via local QR login.

repos.description: 金谷园饺子馆.Skill - 北邮旁的饺子馆
repos.summary_zh: 金谷园饺子馆 AI Skill 是一个基于 MCP 协议的轻量级智能服务，专为北邮学生及周边人群提供餐厅信息查询、排队取号、外卖服务、生饺烹饪指导及店内 Wi-Fi 密码等六项核心功能，支持 Streamable HTTP 传输，部署于腾讯云函数，实现 AI 助手与实体餐饮服务的无缝对接。
repos.summary_en: The JinGuYuan Dumpling Skill is a lightweight AI service built on the MCP protocol, offering six core functionalities including restaurant info, queue management, delivery, frozen dumpling cooking guidance, and in-store Wi-Fi access. It uses Streamable HTTP transport and is deployed via Tencent CloudBase functions, enabling seamless integration between AI assistants and real-world dining services.

repos.description: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI Agent frame.
repos.summary_zh: Aser 是一个轻量级、自组装的 AI 智能体框架，支持模块化组合与快速开发。通过几行代码即可构建具备工具调用、知识库、记忆、MCP 协议等能力的智能体，适用于 Web3、自动化任务和多智能体协作场景，提供丰富的示例与扩展能力。
repos.summary_en: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI agent framework enabling rapid development of modular agents. With just a few lines of code, users can build agents with tools, knowledge retrieval, memory, MCP protocol, and more, ideal for Web3 automation, multi-agent collaboration, and advanced AI workflows.

repos.description: 一个现代化的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，为AI助手提供交互式用户反馈收集功能。
repos.summary_zh: MCP反馈收集器是一个基于Model Context Protocol的现代化反馈收集服务器，专为AI助手设计。支持多图片上传、文字反馈及中文界面，提供700x800像素GUI交互界面，通过uvx一键安装，适用于Claude Desktop等AI工具，显著提升人机交互效率。
repos.summary_en: MCP Feedback Collector is a modern Model Context Protocol server for interactive user feedback collection in AI assistants. It supports multi-image uploads, text feedback, and a Chinese GUI with a 700x800px interface. Installable via uvx, it enhances AI-human interaction in tools like Claude Desktop.

repos.description: Full-featured GUI for Claude Code CLI in VS Code — Windows (no WSL) & macOS. Third-party API, MCP plugins, Skills, Hooks, real-time token tracking. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: 为 Windows 平台打造的 Claude Code 原生聊天界面扩展，提供现代化 UI 和自定义 API 支持，兼容 VS Code 和 Cursor，支持第三方 API 接入，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: A native Windows UI extension for Claude Code that enhances the CLI experience with a modern chat interface, custom API support, and seamless integration with VS Code/Cursor for improved developer productivity.

repos.description: Local-first desktop API client built for developers and AI agents
repos.summary_zh: Voleeo 是一款面向 AI 时代的本地优先桌面 API 客户端，原生支持 HTTP、gRPC、WebSocket 和 GraphQL 四大协议。内置 MCP Server，允许 AI 智能体直接读写工作区、发起请求与管理环境。具备 AES-256-GCM 加密、OAuth 2.0 等全链路认证、Git 版本控制、OpenAPI/Postman 导入及插件扩展能力，零遥测、无云端锁定。
repos.summary_en: Voleeo is a local-first desktop API client built for the AI era, natively supporting HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, and GraphQL in a single app. It doubles as an MCP server, enabling AI agents to read, create, and execute requests directly from chat. Features include AES-256-GCM encryption, full auth suites (OAuth 2.0, SigV4, etc.), Git-based collection versioning, OpenAPI/Postman imports, plugin extensibility, and zero telemetry with no cloud lock-in.

repos.description: A self-hosted MCP relay for native coding runtimes
repos.summary_zh: Agenvo是一个自托管的MCP中继服务，将ChatGPT、Grok Bot等AI助手与运行在本地电脑和服务器的编码代理（如Codex、Herdr）无缝连接。用户可通过AI助手跨设备统一调度、监控和续接编码任务，无需开放入站端口，支持Agent自行重连恢复工作。
repos.summary_en: Agenvo is a self-hosted MCP relay that bridges AI assistants (ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse) with native coding runtimes (Codex, Herdr) on your computers and servers. It enables cross-device agent coordination via WSS connections without inbound ports, letting AI assistants monitor, manage, and resume coding tasks seamlessly.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastMCP 框架的 VSCode 扩展，将 VSCode 转换为 MCP 服务器，支持通过 HTTP Streaming 和 SSE 协议远程执行内部命令，提供工作区信息查询、异步执行、命令白名单等能力，兼容 Model Context Protocol 标准。
repos.summary_en: A VSCode extension using FastMCP framework to convert VSCode into an MCP server, enabling remote execution of internal commands via HTTP Streaming and SSE, with workspace info, async execution, command whitelisting, and full Model Context Protocol compatibility.

repos.description: 一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记、本地知识库、AI 智能助手、向量语义检索 。
repos.summary_zh: OpenNote 是一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记管理、本地知识库构建、AI 智能助手及向量语义检索。具备长期记忆与自我进化能力，通过 MCP 协议与 AI 大模型深度集成，实现知识的高效组织与智能问答，适合个人知识管理与 AI 增强型笔记场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenNote is a cross-platform intelligent note-taking Agent application that supports multi-format note management, local knowledge base building, AI-powered assistance, and vector semantic search. With long-term memory and self-evolving capabilities, it integrates deeply with AI large language models via the MCP protocol, enabling efficient knowledge organization and intelligent Q&A for personal knowledge management and AI-enhanced note-taking scenarios.
